policy.writeAuthority: GitHub is the ONLY formal write source for canonical Engineering Memory. Claude is READ-ONLY on Google Drive: no upload, no create, no overwrite, no update, no archive, no move, no delete/trash, and no Connector-driven delta sync — not even to repair a lagging mirror. The cloud copy is written by GitHub → Drive Sync. Permanent order: GitHub first, Drive second.
policy.supersedes: The create-verify-archive-promote Connector flow described in the rest of this file. It genuinely worked and every recorded "PASS" below really happened — it is retired for COST (per-file agent uploads are slow, bandwidth-heavy, and lengthen every seal), and is now labelled LEGACY_CLAUDE_CONNECTOR_SYNC = RETIRED.
policy.whatThisFileIsNow: Historical sync evidence plus the delta computation that tells the GitHub-side sync WHICH canonical files changed. scripts/meeting-room-delta.mjs still runs and is still unit tested; only the consumer of its output changed — from "Claude uploads these" to "the GitHub → Drive sync uploads these".
policy.whenAutomationNotReady: Report GITHUB_TO_DRIVE_SYNC = PENDING and stop. Never hand-upload to make Drive look current; never report PENDING as PASS.
policy.rule: NORMAL RELEASE = DELTA SYNC. FULL VERIFY = EXCEPTION ONLY.
policy.unchangedMeans: If a canonical file's sha256 equals its last successfully synced sha256, it is UNCHANGED and must receive ZERO Google Drive connector calls: no search, no read-back, no download, no create, no archive, no byte diff. UNCHANGED = SKIP is a hard rule, not a preference.
policy.emptyDelta: If no canonical file changed, finalize:release prints MEETING_ROOM_CLOUD_SYNC = NOT_REQUIRED and the Google Drive Connector must not be opened at all.
policy.fullVerifyReporting: Any run that uses full verify MUST state FULL_VERIFY_REASON = <one of the exceptions above> in its final report. An agent may never start a full verify for its own reassurance.
policy.autoEscalation: manifest-evidence-untrustworthy is the ONLY exception that may be raised automatically (by scripts/meeting-room-delta.mjs) -- without a usable baseline a diff is meaningless, so escalating is the honest option.

note: update_file on this Connector only supports title/parentId, never content -- an existing canonical file is NEVER updated in place. See scripts/finalize-release.mjs and PROJECT_HANDOFF.md for the full protocol writeup. Folder IDs are not secrets and may be committed; no Google credential of any kind is ever stored here.

fallback.note: Kept, never removed. Used only when the Google Drive Connector is unavailable to the executing Claude session.

lastSync.statusNote: The delta planner requires exactly "success" (scripts/meeting-room-delta.mjs, assessManifestEvidence). A previous run recorded "PASS" here, which the planner correctly treated as untrustworthy evidence and escalated to a full verify. The sync itself had genuinely succeeded and was byte-verified; only the label was wrong. Keep this value as "success" — never widen the planner to accept other spellings, because that guard is what stops an unverified manifest from being trusted.
lastSync.performedBy: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/sync-engineering-memory.yml) run #9, conclusion=success. Claude performed ZERO Drive writes — read-only verification only, per DRIVE_SYNC_GOVERNANCE_V2.
lastSync.detail: V1.9.0 root-cause release：quad（事故）CCTV prepare-timeout 可觀測性修復。真人事故 2026-08-26 09:20 國3南向96K+700，09:30 同一事件重跑即成功。確認 Root Cause：quad 路徑完全沒有 stage 追蹤，因此任何一次真實延遲都無法留下紀錄。修復比照單鏡頭路徑加上 stageTracker，7 個新欄位（metadataElapsedMs/cameraSelectionElapsedMs/frameFetchElapsedMs/collageElapsedMs/successfulFrameCount/failedFrameCount/r2PublishElapsedMs）＋既有 timeoutStage 接進 Pipeline Trace。RETRY_REQUIRED=NO，未新增任何 retry 或調整 4000ms。APP_VERSION 同 commit bump 為 V1.9.0（三段式版本治理生效後第一個正式版本）。6 個 canonical 檔案由 GitHub Actions 於 02:42 更新，4 個未變更者保留 07:44 時間戳。唯讀查證：10/10 present、0 missing、0 duplicate，Drive 端 byte size 與本地 engineering-memory/ 完全一致。
lastSync.loopAvoidanceNote: This round deliberately did NOT let the export churn. Running finalize:release re-generates the export, which moves generatedAt and manufactures a 4-file "delta" out of nothing — the export/commit/SHA/export loop the order forbids. That regeneration was reverted with git checkout, the real hashes were compared against this file, and the export was regenerated exactly ONCE after the two memory edits. sourceMainHead (979182b, the release described) stays separate from exportArtifactCommit (the commit carrying the artifact), which is what stops the self-reference loop.
